summary: Ward 11 contains a number of fraternity and sorority residences that provide accommodation for four or more students. In exchange for payment, students occupy dwelling rooms that are comparable to the dwelling rooms that will be regulated under the Multi-tenant House Licensing By-law when it comes into force in April 2024. At present, fraternities and sororities are not required to hold a city licence in order to provide such accommodation. The Multi-tenant House Licensing By-law is intended to ensure that those who pay to occupy dwelling rooms have a safe, adequate and dignified place to live, that the facility is known to comply with applicable laws, and that an owner and person in charge are clearly identified and accountable for its legal compliance. In 2018 staff delivered a report, Fraternity and Sorority Houses Exemption to Chapter 285, Rooming Houses and through that report, were directed by council to identify licensing requirements for fraternity and sorority housing (see adopted recommendation number three, https://secure.toronto.ca/council/agenda-item.do?item=2018.LS25.2 ). After that review, staff recommended that MTH licensing requirements should apply to fraternity and sorority residences.
